question: Where and with what substance should the feet be anointed?
premises: The anointing is done at the root of butea and walnut trees
The substance used is nectar of the face
inference: One should anoint both feet at the root of butea and walnut trees with face-nectar.
uncertainties: vadana-amṛtena may refer to saliva or a ritualized nectar
plain_english: Having anointed both feet at the root of the butea and walnut tree with the nectar of the mouth.
